P.name: Crimson Pact
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Vladimir''' gains {{as|({{fd|3.333}}% '''bonus''' health)}} as {{sti|ap|{{as|ability power}}}} and {{as|(160% AP)}} as {{sti|health|{{as|'''bonus''' health}}}}. These two bonuses do not stack with each other.

Q.name: Transfusion
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Vladimir''' drains blood from the target enemy, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|heal|healing}} himself. He then generates 1 point of ''{{tip|Fury|Crimson Rush}}'' over the {{sti|cooldown}}.
Q.description2: At 2 points of ''{{tip|Fury|Crimson Rush}}'', '''Vladimir''' surges, gaining {{sti|ms|{{as|{{pp|10%;20%;30%;40%|1;6;11;16}} '''bonus''' movement speed}}|ms}} decaying over {{fd|0.5}} seconds while the ''{{tip|Fury|Crimson Rush}}'' depletes over {{fd|2.5}} seconds. ''{{tip|Fury|Crimson Rush}}'' depletes 75% slower during ''{{ai|Sanguine Pool|Vladimir}}'', ''{{ai|Tides of Blood|Vladimir}}'', or {{tip|stasis (buff)|stasis}}.
Q.description3: Casting ''Transfusion'' during the surge consumes all ''{{tip|Fury|Crimson Rush}}'' to deal {{ccs|85% increased damage|magic}} and {{tip|heal}} '''Vladimir''' for an additional {{pp|30 + (200-30)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=heal}} {{as|(+ 5% {{as|(+ 4% per 100 AP)}} of his '''missing''' health)}}. The additional healing is reduced to{{ft|35%|{{pp|30*0.35 + (200*0.35-30*0.35)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=heal}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5*0.35}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|4*0.35}}% per 100 AP)}} of his '''missing''' health)}}}}against {{tip|minions}}.

Q.description2: At 2 points of ''{{tip|Fury|Crimson Rush}}'', '''Vladimir''' surges, gaining {{sti|ms|{{as|{{pp|10%;20%;30%;40%|1;6;11;16}} '''bonus''' movement speed}}|ms}} decaying over {{fd|0.5}} seconds while the ''{{tip|Fury|Crimson Rush}}'' depletes over {{fd|2.5}} seconds. W.name: Sanguine Pool
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Vladimir''' sinks into a pool of blood, becoming {{tip|untargetable}} and {{tip|ghosted}} for 2 seconds. He also gains {{sti|ms|{{as|{{fd|37.5}}% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays exponentially over 1 second.
W.description2:
Enemies within the pool are dealt {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds over the duration and are {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 40%.
'''Vladimir''' {{tip|heals}} himself for 30% of the {{tt|pre-mitigation damage|Damage calculated before modifiers}} dealt, reduced to {{ap|30*0.6}}% against {{tip|minions}}.
W.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{ap|20 to 75}} {{as|(+ {{fd|3.75}}% '''bonus''' health)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|20*4 to 75*4}} {{as|(+ 15% '''bonus''' health)}}}}
W.description3: '''''Vladimir''' cannot use basic attacks nor abilities during Sanguine Pool, but he can still move. If {{ai|Tides of Blood|Vladimir}} is charging at the time of Sanguine Pool's activation, that ability may still be recast.''

E.name: Tides of Blood
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Vladimir''' {{tip|channel|charges}} for up to {{fd|1.5}} seconds, during which he increases ''Tides of Blood's'' damage over the first second of the channel, and becomes {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 20% afterwards for the remaining duration. ''Tides of Blood'' can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards or if it is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}.
E.description2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Vladimir''' unleashes a nova of 15 blood bolts around himself that each deal {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit, increased based on charge time up to the first second.
E.leveling2: {{st|Minimum Magic Damage|{{ap|30 to 90}} {{as|(+ {{fd|1.5}}% '''maximum''' health)}} {{as|(+ 35% AP)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|60 to 180}} {{as|(+ 6% '''maximum''' health)}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}}}}
E.description3: If ''Tides of Blood'' was charged for at least 1 second, enemies hit are also {{tip|slow|slowed}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.
E.description4: ''Enemies can intercept multiple bolts, but can be damaged only once.''
E.description5: ''If '''Vladimir''' is below {{as|12% of his '''maximum''' health}}, Tides of Blood will not cost any {{as|health}}.''

R.name: Hemoplague
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Vladimir''' spreads a virulent plague at the target location that infects enemies hit for 4 seconds, increasing the damage they take from all sources by 10%.
R.description2: After the duration, the infection bursts to deal {{as|magic damage}} to all affected targets and, after a {{fd|0.4}}-second delay, {{tip|heal}} '''Vladimir''' for each infected champion, reduced to 40% for champions beyond the first.
